members.name: message
members.doc: What the notification says, in one short sentence. It is required, and a blank string does not count.

members.name: title
members.doc: Says what the message is about. Without one, the notification shows Notification.

members.name: variant
members.doc: How the notification looks, by what happened. It does not change how long the notification stays.

members.name: duration
members.doc: How long the notification stays, in milliseconds. 0 keeps it until it is dismissed or removed. Must be finite, not negative, and at most 2147483647. Changing it replaces the notification with a new one.

members.name: onDismiss
members.doc: Reports the notification being dismissed, by a person or a timeout, at most once. An unmount does not call it.
